new.n: Murdered recluse Mons Jacobson's hidden money, farm S of Silent Lake
new.pl: Jacobson farm, S part of sec 32 T136N R41W (Dora Twp), between the south shore of Silent Lake and the Dora/Star Lake line road
new.v: "Considerable money" he reputedly hid about the farm (no figure)
new.st: Mons Jacobson, a bachelor recluse of about 70-75 who had run a small store, was beaten, shot and tied to a stall in his horse barn about 11 Jul 1932 (found 15 Jul). The killers ripped out floors and walls looking for the money he reputedly hid about his farm. A suspect was arrested at Fargo, but the case stayed unsolved and was later grouped with the 1933-35 northwest Minnesota "madman" killings. No recovery was ever reported.
new.t: The killers wrecked the house in 1932, so search the outbuilding sites, fence lines and garden. No farmstead shows on the 1939 aerial. C, not B: the money is only "reputed" and the killers may have found it. Private land: permission needed.
